scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a solo week in Maui, [X] plans repeated reef snorkeling, coastal walks, historical stops, and sunsets, comparing a mask and a separate pair of sunglasses by salt-water care, fog treatment, wet packing, optical clarity, carrying weight, and resistance to ordinary travel handling.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 独自前往毛伊岛一周时，[X]会安排多次浮潜、海岸步行、历史景点参观和日落活动，并从盐水护理、防雾处理、潮湿收纳、清晰度、携带重量和一般旅行磕碰等方面比较面镜与另一副太阳镜。
examples: favoring Tri Acetate Cellulose for a lightweight polarized sun pair when glare control and pack weight dominate
favoring Polycarbonate or Nylon when active eyewear must tolerate repeated wet handling
considering Glass only when optical and scratch benefits justify extra weight and careful storage

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For recurring organic treatment of older peach and apple trees, [X] prepares seasonal sprays with copper, dormant oil, sulfur, and spinosad and chooses protective eyewear that can remain clear through overhead mist and residue, be rinsed after each pass, and be checked against product labels for chemical compatibility and protection rating.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为老桃树和苹果树进行周期性有机处理时，[X]会按季节准备铜制剂、休眠油、硫磺和多杀菌素，并选择能在头顶喷雾和残留物中保持清晰、每次使用后可冲洗，且可依据实际药剂标签核对化学相容性与防护等级的护目镜。
examples: using Polycarbonate when certified coverage and resistance to branch contact are central
considering Plastic or Resin only after checking the complete protector's chemical and cleaning instructions
keeping Acrylic out of a hazard role unless the finished eyewear carries the required certification

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With one hundred dollars fixed for new computer eyeglasses and prescription needs still unresolved, [X] reserves money for anti-reflection and a comfortable frame and compares lens substrates by all-day weight, text clarity, care requirements, thickness, and how much of the total budget they consume.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把新电脑眼镜的总预算固定为一百美元、且处方需求尚未确定时，[X]会为抗反光和舒适镜架预留预算，并按全天重量、文字清晰度、护理要求、厚度和占用总预算的程度比较镜片基材。
examples: choosing Plastic or Resin when ordinary prescription use, low weight, and affordability dominate
choosing Polycarbonate when lower weight and added toughness justify a different budget split
considering Glass only after accepting its weight and handling demands

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning a Tracer cosplay, [X] compares orange-lens pilot or welding goggles to modify for the headpiece, balancing character recognition, visibility, low costume weight, attachment, and convention handling while keeping cosmetic inserts distinct from certified protective lenses.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在规划 Tracer cosplay 时，[X]会比较可改装到头饰上的橙色飞行员护目镜或焊接护目镜，在角色辨识度、视野、服装重量、安装方式和漫展使用之间权衡，同时明确区分装饰性透明片与经过认证的防护镜片。
examples: favoring Polycarbonate when a worn donor goggle must stay light and tolerate repeated handling
using Plastic or Resin when an available molded donor already meets visibility and wear requirements
using Acrylic only as a cosmetic insert unless the completed eyewear has the needed safety rating

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While supervising a child's recycled-material craft with cardboard, cleaned containers, paint, glue, and scissors, [X] selects child-sized protective eyewear that stays light, clear, secure, and comfortable enough to remain on during messy, stop-and-start work.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 陪同孩子用纸板、清洗后的容器、颜料、胶水和剪刀制作再生材料手工时，[X]会选择尺寸适合儿童、轻便清晰、稳固舒适，能让孩子在零散而容易弄脏的制作过程中持续佩戴的护目镜。
examples: favoring Polycarbonate when ordinary drops and child-sized certified protection matter most
considering Plastic or Resin when an inexpensive pair still provides the needed clarity, coverage, and rating
rejecting a material label by itself when the complete eyewear's safety performance is unknown

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a first Mediterranean shore-fishing trip around Alexandria's rocks and harbor walls, [X] compares polarized sunglasses by low-angle glare control, detail on the water, salt-spray cleaning, carrying weight, retention, and the consequences of handling them near hard surfaces and tackle.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为首次在亚历山大附近礁石和港墙边进行地中海岸钓做准备时，[X]会从低角度眩光控制、水面细节、盐雾清洁、携带重量、固定性以及在硬质地面和钓具附近操作的后果等方面比较偏光太阳镜。
examples: favoring Tri Acetate Cellulose when a light polarized fishing pair is the main need
favoring Polycarbonate or Nylon when wraparound toughness and low weight take priority
considering Glass when optical and scratch benefits justify weight and careful retention

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While learning to swim as an adult, [X] prepares for repeated shallow-water acclimatization, bubbles, floating, gliding, and kickboard drills, comparing swimming goggles by clear underwater vision, pressure and flex, fog and cleaning, comfort during readjustment, and ordinary poolside handling.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 成年后开始学习游泳时，[X]需要反复进行浅水适应、吐气泡、漂浮、滑行和浮板踢腿练习，并按水下视野、受压与弯曲、防雾与清洁、反复调整时的舒适度及泳池边日常磕碰来比较泳镜。
examples: favoring Polycarbonate when repeated submersion and poolside knocks make toughness important
considering Plastic or Resin when a light beginner pair already provides reliable fit and clarity
considering Nylon when a flexible sport-lens construction improves repeated handling without distorting the view

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Across dim classrooms, long reading, phone study, outdoor PE, and computer work, [X] repeatedly wears and cleans the same prescription glasses for nearsightedness, using smears, rough wiping, all-day weight, and minor school-day handling as evidence when considering a future lens material.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在昏暗教室、长时间阅读、手机学习、户外体育课和电脑工作中，[X]会反复佩戴并清洁同一副近视处方眼镜，并把污迹、粗糙擦拭、全天重量和校园日常使用作为以后选择镜片材质的依据。
examples: favoring Polycarbonate when one light pair must also tolerate an active school day
favoring Plastic or Resin when budget, ordinary correction, and all-day weight dominate
considering Glass only when surface and optical benefits outweigh added weight and careful handling

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before learning motorcycle startup, controls, and low-speed practice, [X] adds eye protection and compares certified riding eyewear by helmet compatibility, moving-air clarity, resistance to grit and airborne debris, low weight, and repeated removal between practice sessions.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 开始学习摩托车启动、操控和低速练习前，[X]会先把护眼装备加入清单，并按头盔兼容性、行驶气流中的清晰度、对砂砾和飞散物的防护、重量以及练习间反复摘戴来比较经过认证的骑行眼镜。
examples: favoring Polycarbonate when impact certification and low helmet weight dominate
considering Nylon for a flexible wraparound construction that works with the riding position
rejecting ordinary Plastic, Acrylic, Resin, or Glass when the complete product lacks the required riding protection

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While installing a bracketed shelf on a concrete wall, [X] selects safety glasses for marking level holes, masonry drilling, dust cleanup, and anchor placement, requiring clear pencil-mark visibility, particle coverage, secure retention, and a certified construction rather than relying on a transparent material name alone.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在混凝土墙上安装带支架的置物架时，[X]会为找平标孔、砌体钻孔、清理粉尘和安装膨胀件选择安全眼镜；它需要保证铅笔标记可见、遮挡飞散颗粒、佩戴稳固，并以完整产品认证为依据，而不能只看透明材料名称。
examples: favoring Polycarbonate when fast particles make certified impact protection central
considering Nylon where a flexible wraparound construction improves coverage and retention
rejecting ordinary Plastic, Acrylic, Resin, or Glass unless the complete protector is rated for the drilling hazard
